verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's source is public on GitHub (github.com/opentofu/opentofu), and its manifesto commits to being 'truly open source' under a well-known, widely accepted license as a Linux Foundation project. A community member independently confirms the license is easy to find in the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence, and a community member notes the license is not clearly shown on the website.
